title: A diagnostic method: reproduce, isolate, test and confirm

videos.script: A ticket says something does not work. The temptation is to start fixing: restart it, reinstall it, change a setting and see. {{temptation}} Sometimes that works, and then nobody knows why. Sometimes it makes a second problem on top of the first. {{second}} This lesson gives you four steps that work on any fault, on any system. Reproduce it, so you see what the user saw. Isolate it, by ruling out what works. Test one cause at a time. And confirm it is gone, from where the user sits. {{four}} You will follow the four on a real ticket: an intranet page that opens on one computer and not on another. {{ticket}}
